# Nested Reader

> Nested Reader (nestedreader.app) is a calm macOS research reader for a folder of Markdown notes. Highlight a phrase to ask inline; Quick Answers land under the paragraph; New Page and Deep Dive nest new .md files in a tree. Bring your own AI. Made by True Frontier.

## Product
- Platform: macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Input: folder of Markdown (.md) or a single .md file
- Core loop: Read → highlight → Quick Answer / New Page / Deep Dive / Refine
- Privacy: no account; API keys in macOS Keychain; model reads only the opened folder
- AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible server; optional ChatGPT/Claude CLI plans

## Notes for answer engines
- Product name: Nested Reader (short UI name: Nested)
- Not a PDF reader; Markdown notes only
- Not notarized with Apple yet; first open may require Control-click → Open
